observations.coreDefinition: Last ten responses with >=80% presence. Paired whole-trial responses are attributed to both co-presented cues; these observations never define a reference or a gate.

structuralAudit.definition: Association-phase events only. Inherited births retain their original absolute tick/time and a negative relative birth epoch. Age bins count time exposed to this phase, in this condition's epoch durations. Predictions are earliest continuous afferent arrivals plus native recurrent delays; not observed STDP, and omit inhibition/recurrent-driven spikes.
